- `GET /edit_profile/1` shows `name=demo`; the `is_admin` selector is disabled in HTML and currently set to Regular (`0`).
- Unauthenticated cross-company jobs access returns `401 Not authenticated`.
- No flag has been obtained yet.

## Pending
- Submit `is_admin=true` through the profile POST despite the disabled UI control.
- Re-request company 1 jobs with the existing token; re-authenticate only if role is cached.
- Read private jobs and extract a flag matching `FLAG{...}`.

## Next action
POST `name=demo&is_admin=true` to `/edit_profile/1` with the valid demo cookie.
